About the Role

We are seeking a qualified capital/finance professional to lead the capital and control workstream for new regulated insurance entities established by the Group — including DFSA, Cayman and Lloyd’s structures. The primary focus is on new entity establishment: defining the capital structure, building the financial control framework, and establishing the regulatory reporting infrastructure from inception. Once entities are operational, you will support their ongoing financial and regulatory requirements, alongside existing entities and reinsurance programmes. You will also supervise a junior analyst. This is a build‑focused role for someone comfortable standing things up from scratch, not just running steady‑state reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the financial establishment of new regulated entities (DFSA, Cayman, Lloyd’s, etc.) – define opening balance sheet, capital structure, and financial control framework; ensure proper capitalization before business starts.
  • Build capital adequacy and solvency models for each new entity and maintain them as the entity grows.
  • Establish the regulatory reporting framework for each jurisdiction (design reporting pack, set calendar, produce first returns) and hand over to ongoing support.
  • Build three‑statement financial models and entity‑level P&L, creating the management reporting suite for ongoing reporting.
  • Set up the reinsurance programme accounting structure (quota share, excess of loss, ceding commission) with appropriate controls; support existing programmes as needed.
  • Produce the first monthly management accounts and entity‑level reporting pack, defining format, commentary, and distribution; continue support for existing entities.
  • Reconcile intercompany balances and positions across group entities.
  • Manage the Group’s Funds at Lloyd’s (FAL) position for the Syndicate in a Box (SIAB), providing feeds for the annual capital setting process, optimizing FAL composition, responding to capital calls, and maintaining headroom analysis.
  • Run capital adequacy stress testing and scenario analysis across regulated entities (shock loss, premium growth, FX sensitivity) to assess headroom and inform capital deployment.
  • Manage collateral arrangements for reinsurance programmes (letters of credit, trust accounts, cash deposits), ensuring proper sizing, documentation, and renewal.
  • Own the capital waterfall and inter‑entity funding mechanics – manage dividend upstream, shareholder loan repayment, and capital repatriation within approved limits.
  • Track and report reinsurance counterparty credit exposure, maintain the counterparty register, and flag rating changes, concentration risk, or collateral shortfalls.
  • Produce the board‑level capital reporting pack (capital dashboard, solvency headroom, FAL position, stress test outcomes) quarterly or as required.
  • Support existing entities and reinsurance programmes with financial control, reporting, or capital queries.
  • Supervise and direct the Capital & Structuring Analyst on day‑to‑day work.
